description: This file contains interface definitions for various grain types and related classes used in Orleans, a framework for distributed applications. It includes grain interfaces for persistence, memory storage, state management, and user interactions, as well as data classes like PersistenceTestGrainState.

classes.name: PersistenceTestGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class representing the state of a persistence test grain, containing integer, string, and a sorted dictionary of integers.

classes.name: MyPredicate
classes.description: Implementation of IMyPredicate that filters integers based on a preset filter value.
